messages:
elena: PTAL — pushed updates to PR #4632. Addressed Alex's serialization nits, rebased, and added a small smoke script + unit test for the kv rotation edge case. Also reduced default batch size for legacy clients behind a feature flag. Would appreciate a quick +1 and a canary slot. cc @alex @raj

elena: Smoke steps (run locally or via CI):
```
# smoke.sh
./bin/smoke --pr 4632 --env staging --requests 100 --concurrency 5
```

alex: skimmed — left one tiny naming nit inline, otherwise LGTM. please rebase (or I can if you're busy). also agree feature flag should default to off in prod.

elena: fixed the naming nit and rebased onto main. feature flag now off by default and noted in CHANGELOG.

raj: starting the smoke job on staging, will report back in ~10m.

ci-bot: Smoke job queued: job/4632-smoke-1798890001 — https://ci.internal/jobs/4632-smoke (running)

raj: smoke passed on staging, no obvious regressions in regression suite.

morgan: quick question — do we have perf numbers for the batch-size tweak? want to check tail latencies before canary.

elena: added perf snapshot in the PR comments: 95th went from ~120ms -> ~130ms; 99th roughly unchanged. overall token throughput slightly improved, CPU at ~-6%. linked the CSV and flame graphs in the PR.

morgan: thanks, minor 95th bump is fine for the use case. +1 from me.

alex: approved. ops: can we schedule canary for a weekday morning, prefer 9:00am PST?

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved: 2026-03-19 09:00 PST (us-west-2) — slot id canary-78. Runbook: /runbooks/canary-kv-rotation.md

elena: awesome, thanks everyone. tagging release-ops to confirm the rollback budget and monitor set. PTAL again if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
